head: codex/5802-drive-recursive-mirror
title: [v0.92][google-workspace] Complete recursive company Drive mirror
body:
## Summary

- deploy the complete recursive ADL context mirror to the Agent Logic company Drive only
- cache the OAuth authenticator once per process and add bounded concurrent folder/file synchronization with deterministic result ordering
- retain redacted auth source/scopes, exact native report, independent byte readback, and stable binary deployment evidence
- activate the daily company-only mirror automation after complete acceptance

## Acceptance

- 2,991 files and 654 required folders verified exactly
- all 16 CodeFriend documents verified byte-for-byte with no duplicate paths
- three zero-byte Markdown files preserved exactly
- final native pass: 2,991 unchanged, zero skipped, zero verification failures
- independent readback: zero missing, unexpected, duplicate, or mismatched paths
- stable automation binary SHA-256 matches the accepted branch build

## Validation

- `cargo test --offline adl_gws_context_mirror` (12 passed)
- typed retained-live acceptance lane (passed)
- `git diff --check`
- independent subagent review PASS at exact reviewed revision

Closes #5802
